intro.say: Brineville. A town that runs on pickles... and tonight, somebody stole its heart.
Better talk to the Mayor before she honks herself into orbit.

style_guide.prompt: Hand-painted 1990s cartoon point-and-click adventure game art, bold dark outlines, saturated warm palette, painterly gouache textures, slightly exaggerated wonky perspective.
style_guide.background_rules: 16:9, no characters, lower third open floor for walking, no text except signage.
style_guide.character_rules: Full body, 3/4 view, flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background for chroma key; portraits cropped from the same render.

defaults.talk: It's not much of a conversationalist.

quarter.name: quarter
quarter.look: One shiny quarter. Smells faintly of booth.

saltines.name: saltines
saltines.look: A sleeve of saltines. Dry as the Mayor's sense of humor.

badge.name: badge
badge.look: A temporary detective badge. It's a sticker. It says 'HELLO MY NAME IS: DETECTIVE'.

key.name: basement key
key.look: A brass key. The tag reads 'BASEMENT - GUS ONLY - THIS MEANS YOU'.

flashlight.name: flashlight
flashlight.look: A little flashlight, slightly chewed. Still works.

trophy.name: Golden Pickle
trophy.look: The Golden Pickle Trophy! Dripping with brine and civic pride.

voice.notes: Gravelly mid-pitch noir narrator, dry deadpan delivery
Deep, slow, gruff walrus; wet mustache consonants

do.say: He's polka-ing like nobody's watching. Everybody's watching.
Gus the cook. Walrus. Grump. Standing awfully close to that basement key.
Can't talk! Feet! Polka! OOM-PAH!
Kitchen's closed, bandit. Unless you got a badge, scram.
He weighs about as much as a pickup truck.
I MAKE the crackers around here, pal.

voice.notes: High, fast, operatic, perpetually on the verge of a honk

do.say: Mayor Marge. A goose in crisis. Which is every goose, but more so.
Grabbing the Mayor is how you end up on a wanted poster.
MY PICKLE! You found it! Put it right back on the pedestal where it belongs!
And arrest Gus. He hid it in his own pickle barrel.
Sore loser! Brineville is SAVED!
Captain Squawks, crunching saltines in his nest of stolen shiny junk.
A pirate parrot with a nest full of shiny stolen junk. Is that a flashlight he's hugging?
CRUNCH! Pleasure doin' business! SQUAWK!
SQUAWK! No shinies for free! CRACKERS! Crackers or NOTHIN'!
He's way up on that lamppost. Also, he bites.
CRACKERS! Arr, a fair trade! Take this shiny stick!
He drops a little flashlight. It's only slightly chewed.
Shiny, but not CRUNCHY! SQUAWK!
Brineville Diner. Home of the 3-pickle breakfast.
The Golden Pickle, back where it belongs.
An empty pedestal. The plaque reads: 'GOLDEN PICKLE TROPHY. DO NOT LICK.'
The Golden Pickle returns to its rightful throne.
MY PICKLE! Detective, you're a hero! But who took it?!
Gus. Hid it in his own pickle barrel. Sore loser from last year's contest.
I KNEW IT! Brineville is SAVED! Someone fetch a polka band... for his trial!
Today's headline: 'PICKLE PILFERED! TOWN IN A PICKLE!' Journalism is dead.
It wants a quarter for a paper whose headline I can already read.
Nah. I'm not wasting my only quarter on a paper I can read through the glass.
A lamppost with a parrot nest on top. Brineville's finest urban planning.
I'd shimmy up, but this coat is dry-clean only.
The way out to Main Street.
Basement's off limits, ringtail. Gus only.
Locked. Of course it's locked.
The basement door, unlocked. Smells like brine and guilt.
A door to the basement, with a big red arrow pointing down. Subtle.
Click. The basement door is unlocked.
A brass key on a hook, right next to the basement door. Convenient for Gus. And me.
Paws off the key, bandit, or you're the soup of the day.
Swiping keys without an official case? That's just burglary. I need the Mayor to hire me first.
Official detective business. Totally legal. Probably.
A family-size box of saltines. Brineville's second favorite food.
I've got plenty. Any more and I'll turn into a cracker.
I'll take a sleeve. For evidence.
A squishy red booth cushion. Things fall in there and are never seen again.
Just crumbs and regret left in there.
Aha! Buried treasure: one quarter, two fries, and a button.
I could sit, but crime never sleeps. Or sits.
'Dill With It (Polka Remix)'. On repeat. Forever.
A jukebox. Every record is scratched except one: 'Dill With It (Polka Remix)'. Takes quarters.
It's already playing. Gus might never stop.
It needs a quarter.
One quarter, one polka.
Is that... 'Dill With It'?! My flippers! They won't stop! OOM-PAH-PAH!
And just like that, the key's unguarded.
The kitchen. Grease, pots, and a sign: 'EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH: GUS (ONLY EMPLOYEE)'.
A painting of Brineville back when it was Cucumberton. Dark times.
Stairs back up to the diner.
Pitch black. Something big in the middle is glowing faintly... green.
Click. Let there be light. And pickles. So many pickles.
Just pickles now. Regular, non-golden pickles.
A giant pickle barrel. The lid's ajar, and something down there is glowing GOLD-ish green.
I'm not fishing in there again. My paws are already pruney.
I fish around in the brine and... THE GOLDEN PICKLE TROPHY! Gus, you sour, sour walrus.
I should reach in and pick up whatever's glowing in there.
Jars labeled 'DILL', 'EXTRA DILL', and 'DILL WITH IT'. The man has a theme.
I've got all the pickle I need. The golden kind.
A burnt-out bulb. Gus likes his crimes in the dark.
Dead. Totally dead.

lines.say: Detective! The Golden Pickle Trophy has been STOLEN! Our pride! Our identity! Our BRINE!
Splendid! Here's a temporary badge. Flash it and people will HAVE to talk to you.
Well... Gus the cook DID lose last year's pickle-eating contest to me. He's been sour ever since. And he hasn't left that diner all day!
Captain Squawks? He steals anything shiny. Utter menace! Only thing he loves more than shinies is crackers.
A badge, huh. Make it quick. I got hash browns burnin'.
Here. Mopping. Alone. Not near any trophies. Why, what'd you hear?
Pickles. Brine. Nothing shiny. Nothing trophy-shaped. Stop asking.
Polka. Can't resist it. If that jukebox plays 'Dill With It', my flippers got a mind of their own.

puzzles.name: Polka on the jukebox distracts Gus
Trade saltines to the parrot for a flashlight
Fish the trophy out of the barrel

win.title: CASE CLOSED
win.text: The Golden Pickle is home, Gus is doing community service at the polka hall, and Rocco got paid in saltines. Brineville is saved.
